# mkdir

Create directories and optional parent paths through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/mkdir -p output/reports

moonx cli/mkdir -m 700 private-dir
```

Attempt all operands, preserving existing directory modes with -p. Explicit mode setting is available on POSIX hosts.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-p`, `--parents` | Create missing parent directories. |
| `-m VALUE`, `--mode VALUE` | Set the leaf mode, numeric or supported symbolic. |
| `-v`, `--verbose` | Show created directories. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Notes

Build from source with the MoonBit 1.0 RC1 toolchain.

- Symbolic modes that depend on the current umask are rejected. Restrictive parent permissions may leave already-created parents and return status 2.
- Windows rejects -m when creation is needed; -p on existing directories remains a successful no-op.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
